title: 第一三五五章 你算是我的朋友第一三五四章 叶入混沌花作尘
content_zh:
“嘭！”姜千王的身体从虚空跌落下来，很显然，他的遁术在狄九的困阵之下根本就是个笑话。
狄九看见姜千王遁走，立即就知道不好。
果然虚暮伦看见姜千王被困阵挡住，立即就是一怔，随即他毫不犹豫的后退一步，那无尽的金叶立即分出一半，裹住了虚暮伦的领域。
轰轰轰！连绵狂暴的杀势道则爆裂。之前狄九岁月三张机的七波刀浪都没有撕开的无尽金叶，在这狂暴的杀势道则爆裂下，被撕开了一条通道，虚暮伦的身体出现在了狄九的神通之下。
不过虚暮伦却是松了口气，他没想到狄九的阵道水平竟然到了这种程度。刚才不知不觉的情况下，竟然借助规则布置了一个困杀大阵。若不是姜千王突兀遁逃，他恐怕还真的会被狄九暗算到。
别看他现在的神通碾压住了狄九，但狄九的大道可是非同小可，一旦被狄九抓住机会，很有可能会翻盘。
狄九暗叹一声，他知道自己被姜千王坏了好事。虚暮伦这种实力，他的岁月四张机绝对无法奈何对方，所以狄九根本就没有打算施展出岁月四张机，而是准备激发早已用法则阵旗构建的困杀大阵。
可惜的是，这个困杀大阵被姜千王的遁逃暴露，让虚暮伦有了警觉。困阵暴露狄九只能提前激发绞杀阵，最后只是撕开了虚暮伦的领域，弱化了虚暮伦的神通而已。
放九重看的清楚，他立即就知道狄九的计划被姜千王破坏了。他哪里还会再等下去，九重塔卷起一重又一重的属性规则世界，裹向了姜千王。
如果说之前姜千王还能制住放九重，在被狄九一刀劈开身体，甚至他身体中还有狄九的神通道则流转，姜千王再也无法挡住放九重的九重塔层层杀势。
只是数个呼吸时间，姜千王就被放九重裹进了九重塔的杀势世界之中。
尽管先机已经失去，狄九并没有认了，天娑刀再次一卷，同时一刀劈出。
平平无奇的一刀，比起岁月三张机的那种狂暴刀浪，狄九这一刀就好像微风拂过湖面，只有细微的波纹荡漾。
修为到了极致后，随手一刀也是神通。狄九不是因为明白这个，才随手一刀。而是因为他很清楚，自己的一切神通对眼前的虚暮伦来说，和随手一刀其实是没有多少区别的。
更何况，狄九这不是随手一刀，这是他的刀道神通，过隙。
自从修为大成后，狄九就极少用这种寻常的刀势神通了。今天他再次用了过隙神通，也实在是无奈，谁让虚暮伦实力如此强悍，而且运气还逆天？
过隙刀光借助之前杀阵爆裂撕开的领域通道，劈向虚暮伦。
如果没有之前的杀阵激发，狄九的过隙绝对无法撕开虚暮伦的金叶法宝和大道领域。绞杀阵虽然被将姜千王影响，提前激发，依然帮助过隙撕开了虚暮伦的神通和大道领域。
狄九强压住内心的激动了，过隙刀的神通道则更是发挥到了极致！
人生天地之间，若白驹之过卻，忽然而已。

“呵呵，也就如此罢了。”虚暮伦手一挥，无穷金叶再次锁住了过隙撕开的细微缝隙，又一次铺天盖地的卷向了狄九。
狄九的过隙神通，真的如白驹过隙，仅仅是在虚暮伦眼里闪了一道灰色的间隙，然后就消失不见。
虚暮伦倒是有些疑惑，狄九的神通很显然是时间神通，那一道灰色间隙显然是过隙神通的效果。不过也就如此罢了，甚至连他的一根毫毛都伤害不了，他不明白，为什么狄九要用这样一招毫无意义的神通。
还有，以狄九的这时间神通，那过隙间隙应该是白色的才是。因为在两人的领域规则之下，这里俨然形成了一个光亮的规则世界，为何他看见的是灰色？
不过这些都不重要了，他的亿万金叶完全卷向了狄九，哪怕他的境界不稳，此刻要碾压狄九也不是什么难事。
狄九知道自己和虚暮伦相差的有些大，面对对方的无尽金叶卷来，他毫不犹豫的祭出了世界书和宙天葫，两件法宝完全护住了他的身体。
content_en:
"Bang!" Jiang Qianwang's body fell from the void. It was obvious that his escape technique was a joke under Di Jiu's trapping formation.
When Di Jiu saw King Jiang Qian running away, he immediately knew something was wrong.
Sure enough, when Xu Mulun saw King Jiang Qian blocked by the formation, he was immediately startled. Then he took a step back without hesitation, and the endless golden leaves immediately separated into half, covering Xu Mulun's domain.
Boom boom boom! The continuous violent killing force exploded. The endless golden leaves that had not been torn apart by the seven waves of knives from Di Jiu's three machines in the past were torn apart by this violent murderous Dao Ze explosion, and Xu Mulun's body appeared under Di Jiu's magical power.
However, Xu Mulun breathed a sigh of relief. He did not expect that Di Jiu's formation level had reached this level. Unknowingly, he had used the rules to set up a trap and kill formation. If King Jiang Qian hadn't escaped unexpectedly, he might have been plotted against by Di Jiu.
Even though his current magical power can overwhelm Di Jiu, Di Jiu's path is very important. Once Di Jiu seizes the opportunity, he is likely to turn the tables.
Di Jiu sighed secretly, knowing that his good deeds had been ruined by King Jiang Qian. With Xu Mulun's strength, his Four Years Machines would never be able to do anything to the opponent, so Di Jiu had no intention of using the Four Years Machines at all, but was preparing to activate the trapping and killing formation that had already been constructed with the Law Formation Flag.
Unfortunately, this trap was exposed by King Jiang Qian's escape, which alerted Xu Mulun. When the trapping formation was exposed, Di Jiu could only activate the strangulation formation in advance, but in the end it just tore apart Xu Mulun's domain and weakened Xu Mulun's magical power.
Fang Jiuzhong could see clearly, and he immediately knew that Di Jiu's plan had been ruined by King Jiang Qian. How could he wait any longer? The nine-layered tower rolled up the world of attribute rules one after another and wrapped them around King Jiang Qian.
If Jiang Qianwang could restrain Fang Jiuzhong before, but after his body was split open by Di Jiu with a knife, and even Di Jiu's divine passages were flowing in his body, Jiang Qianwang could no longer block Fang Jiuzhong's killing force at every level in the Jiuzhong Tower.
In just a few breaths, King Jiang Qian was wrapped up into the murderous world of the nine-layered tower.
Although the opportunity was lost, Di Jiu did not admit it. The Tiansuo knife rolled up again and struck out with one strike at the same time.
Compared with the violent wave of swords of the Three-Square Machine of Time, Di Jiu's sword was like a gentle breeze blowing across the lake, with only subtle ripples rippling.
After reaching the extreme level of cultivation, even a casual sword can be used as a magical power. Di Jiu didn't just kill him casually because he understood this. But because he knew very well that to Xu Mulun in front of him, all his magical powers were not much different from a casual knife.
What's more, Di Jiu didn't just use the sword casually, it was his magical power of sword that passed through the gap.
Since his cultivation, Di Jiu rarely used this kind of ordinary sword power. Today he used the magical power again, but he was really helpless. Who made Xu Mulun so powerful and so lucky?
The sword light passed through the gap and slashed towards Xu Mulun with the help of the domain channel that was torn apart by the explosion of the previous killing array.
Without the activation of the previous killing formation, Di Jiu's passage would never have been able to tear apart Xu Mulun's golden leaf magic weapon and the avenue realm. Although the strangulation array was influenced by General Jiang Qianwang and activated in advance, it still helped Guo Gao to tear apart Xu Mulun's magical power and avenue realm.
Di Jiu suppressed the excitement in his heart, and the magical channel of Guo Xiandao was brought to its extreme!
In life, between heaven and earth, if a white horse passes by, it will happen suddenly.
"Haha, that's it." Xu Mulun waved his hand, and the infinite golden leaves once again locked the tiny gap that had been opened, and once again rolled towards Di Jiu overwhelmingly.
Di Jiu's magical power was really like a white horse passing through a gap. It just flashed a gray gap in Xu Mulun's eyes, and then disappeared.
Xu Mulun was a little confused. Di Jiu's magical power was obviously the magical power of time, and the gray gap was obviously the effect of the magical power of passing through gaps.fruit. But that's it, it couldn't even hurt a hair on his head. He didn't understand why Di Jiu used such a meaningless magical power.
Also, with Di Jiu's magical power of time, the gap should be white. Because under the rules of the two people's fields, a bright world of rules seemed to be formed here. Why did he see gray?
But these are not important anymore, his billions of golden leaves are completely rolled towards Di Jiu. Even if his realm is unstable, it is not difficult to crush Di Jiu at this moment.
Di Jiu knew that there was a big difference between himself and Xu Mulun. Facing the opponent's endless golden leaves, he did not hesitate to use the World Book and the Eternal Sky Gourd. The two magic weapons completely protected his body.
